blurb: Marshfield Saddle Club is a member-based horse club established in 1953, active in the central Wisconsin horse community. They host open horse shows sanctioned by the North Central Wisconsin Horsemen's Association. The club offers scholarships for members who are high school seniors going to college.
extraNote: Scholarship application due December 15th of the application year · Show grounds located 1 1/2 miles north of Marshfield on County Highway E
